extracted.name: Chive Fry Bread
ingredient_lines: 2 cups all-purpose flour plus more for dusting
As needed peanut oil to fry in
instruction_lines: Mix the ingredients except the butter. Add flour ontop of the mixture so it won't stick to your hands and fingers.
Heat the oil to shallow fry the bread. Turn often to fry all the way through. When done move to paper towels to absorb excessive amounts of oil. Top with butter. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!!
